literal: Strength having desired, mind as companion, he who went; coming having desired, still I exist.
translation: He departed, desiring success in his mission, with his own mind as his companion. I am still alive, desiring only his return.
modern: வெற்றியை விரும்பித் தன் உள்ளத்தையே துணையாகக் கொண்டு சென்றவர், மீண்டும் திரும்பி வருவார் என்று விரும்பி நான் இன்னும் உயிரோடு இருக்கிறேன்.
explanation: The heroine speaks of the contrasting desires that drive her and her lover. He left her because he desired 'uran' (strength of purpose or success in his mission), taking only his own determined mind as his companion. She, however, manages to stay alive only because she desires his 'varal' (return). The repeated word 'nacaii' (having desired) beautifully highlights how his desire for achievement separated them, while her desire for his return is the only thing keeping her alive.
